matching: An expected item is met only when one of its alternatives appears in the agent's answer line; a quote the agent cited but didn't put in its answer doesn't count. Alternatives without letters are matched as a run of numbers (0.30 equals 0.3; symbols and units are ignored). Alternatives with letters are matched as text, ignoring case, spaces, hyphens and punctuation marks normalized by the checker, so a paraphrase doesn't match. A required caveat is met when the answer names it (its first phrase) and one cited quote contains every phrase listed. A number in the answer that no cited quote contains fails the question.
